description: Cache key derivation is a no-op: both branches of the ternary (options?.method ? path : path) return path unconditionally, producing no differentiation.
fix: Remove the ternary and use path directly as the cache key. If method-based cache differentiation is intended, prefix with the method string.

description: toCamel returns new objects but the cache stores them by reference. Consumer mutation of a cached response corrupts the shared cache entry for subsequent readers.
fix: Deep-freeze cached entries in development, or use structuredClone(data) on cache-return before handing to consumers to prevent cache poisoning by mutation.

description: pageMap object and dynamic imports are reconstructed inside the onMouseEnter handler on every hover event, creating 11 new Promise references each time any nav icon is hovered.
fix: Hoist pageMap to module-level constant outside the component so it is defined once. Dynamic imports as module-level side effects are fine.

description: Inline arrow functions for onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave event handlers create new closures on every render of the MENU_ITEMS.map loop, causing unnecessary function allocations.
fix: Extract handlers into named functions (handleMouseEnter, handleMouseLeave) defined outside the map callback to avoid per-item closure recreation.

description: fetchMe is wrapped in useCallback with empty deps but is only consumed by refresh. The indirection adds complexity without benefit.
fix: Inline the fetchMe logic directly inside the refresh callback to remove the unnecessary indirection.

description: ProtectedRoute and AppRoutes both call useAuth() independently, subscribing to auth state changes twice. The loading spinner styles ('加载中...') are duplicated across Suspense fallback and ProtectedRoute.
fix: Extract the shared loading spinner into a named component constant. Consider rendering ProtectedRoute inside AppRoutes to avoid the duplicate useAuth call.

description: No ErrorBoundary at the root App level. The ErrorBoundary in AppLayout (line 189) only wraps the Outlet content. A crash in the AuthProvider, sidebar, or header renders a blank page with no recovery UI.
fix: Wrap the AuthProvider or the entire App component with an ErrorBoundary at the top level (App.tsx) to catch rendering errors in the layout shell itself.

description: logout calls clearCache() from api.ts, creating a tight cross-module coupling between AuthContext and the API client. The API layer should manage its own cache lifecycle independently.
fix: Listen for auth changes (e.g., localStorage removal) inside the api.ts module itself, or use an event emitter pattern so AuthContext does not need to import and call api.clearCache directly.

description: Non-GET cache invalidation uses a fragile path-based heuristic (path.replace(/^/[^/]+/, '').split('/')[0]) that may incorrectly match or miss related cache entries.
fix: Use a deterministic mapping from resource CRUD paths to cache key prefixes, or skip automatic cache invalidation entirely and let callers explicitly invalidate when needed.

description: SQL injection risk: orderBy parameter is string-interpolated directly into the SQL query (ORDER BY ${orderBy}) without validation against an allowlist of valid columns.
fix: Validate orderBy against the fields array passed to crudRoutes. If the value is not in the list of allowed columns, fall back to a safe default.

description: DELETE endpoint returns 200 OK with a body ({deleted: true, id}) instead of the REST-standard 204 No Content with no body.
fix: Change to res.status(204).send() for successful DELETE to align with REST conventions.

description: PUT /:id/password uses an action verb in the URL path (action-oriented instead of resource-oriented), and uses PUT for a non-idempotent operation.
fix: Move to POST /:id/reset-password and ensure the route is documented as a non-idempotent action.

description: Route naming convention inconsistency: /audit-logs uses kebab-case while all other routes (/users, /components, /quotations) use flat-lowercase.
fix: Standardise on a single convention. Prefer /audit-logs (kebab-case) as a best practice, or /auditlogs to match existing patterns.

description: Health check at /api/health uses no version prefix while all other API routes are at /api/v1. The health endpoint also uses an envelope format (status, database, time) while all other endpoints return bare data.
fix: Move health to /api/v1/health for consistency, and consider wrapping CRUD responses in a standard envelope {success: true, data: ...} for uniform structure.

description: Comment says POST /api/auth/login but the actual mounted path is /api/v1/auth/login. Misleading inline documentation across multiple route files.
fix: Update all route file comments to reflect the correct full path mounted at /api/v1 prefix.

description: timerecording is a verb/gerund as a resource name, violating REST noun convention. The same file also inconsistently returns {success: true} for DELETE (no id) vs other files that include the deleted id.
fix: Rename to time-records as the REST resource path. Standardise DELETE response format across all routes to either always include the id or always use 204.

description: audit-logs CRUD route allows full write access (POST/PUT/DELETE) via generic crudRoutes, but audit logs should typically be append-only for security integrity.
fix: Add middleware to audit-logs routes that rejects non-GET requests, or at minimum restrict POST/PUT/DELETE to admin roles only.

description: delivery_projects.opportunity_id is UUID NOT NULL but has no REFERENCES clause, allowing orphan rows if the opportunity is deleted.
fix: Add REFERENCES sales_opportunities(id) ON DELETE CASCADE or ON DELETE SET NULL as appropriate.

description: delivery_projects.quotation_id is VARCHAR(100) instead of UUID with a foreign key, creating a type mismatch and no referential integrity.
fix: Change to UUID type and add REFERENCES quotations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL.

description: approval_requests.quotation_id is VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL but quotations.id is UUID. Type mismatch prevents proper JOIN and foreign key constraint.
fix: Change to UUID type and add REFERENCES quotations(id).

description: sales_opportunities.quotation_id is UUID but has no REFERENCES clause, allowing orphan references to the quotations table.
fix: Add REFERENCES quotations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL.

description: blue_tables table has updated_at but no created_at column. Every other table in the schema has both timestamps.
fix: Add created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() to blue_tables.

description: audit_logs table has both time and created_at columns, both with TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(). These appear to be redundant, causing confusion about which timestamp to query.
fix: Remove the time column (or created_at) and keep only one authoritative timestamp to eliminate confusion.

description: Missing updated_at triggers on tables: quotations, group_items, blue_tables, blue_table_roles, client_contacts, client_history, audit_logs, and users. These tables lack automatic updated_at updates.
fix: Add BEFORE UPDATE triggers for each missing table using the existing update_updated_at() function.

description: client_contacts table has no created_at or updated_at timestamps, making it impossible to track when contacts were added or changed.
fix: Add created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() and updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() columns.

description: client_history table has no created_at or updated_at timestamps.
fix: Add created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() and updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() columns.

description: client_history.status uses VARCHAR(20) instead of the existing opportunity_status enum, allowing arbitrary values not constrained to the domain.
fix: Change status column to use the opportunity_status enum type (or create a dedicated history_status enum).

description: users table is not defined anywhere in schema.sql, yet the backend references public.users extensively for authentication and user management.
fix: Add CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (id UUID PK, email, display_name, title, phone, password_hash, role, is_active, permissions, created_at, updated_at) to schema.sql.

description: timerecording schema and its tables (profiles, time_records, task_assignments, notifications) are not defined in schema.sql, yet the backend references them extensively via timerecording.*.
fix: Add the full timerecording schema definition to schema.sql, including all tables, enums, and foreign keys, so the single schema file remains the complete source of truth.

description: Backend types.ts and frontend types.ts independently define identical TypeScript enums (SourcingType, ItemType, GroupType, ReviewStatus, etc.), creating a drift risk.
fix: Extract shared type definitions into a shared package or mono-repo types module, or generate backend types from the frontend types as the canonical source.

description: Table names are string-interpolated into SQL queries (FROM "${table}") without validation against an allowlist, which could lead to errors with unexpected table names.
fix: Validate table against a registry of known table names before interpolation, or pass table as a parameterised identifier if the driver supports it.

description: components.tags uses TEXT[] array column instead of a normalized many-to-many junction table, bypassing referential integrity to the tags table.
fix: Consider creating a component_tags junction table (component_id UUID, tag_id UUID) with foreign key constraints to enforce referential integrity.
